Tierney L. Cross | The Washington Post | Getty Images SpaceX said Wednesday it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account , and CEO Elon Musk would personally match the gift. "SpaceX is building the infrastructure of the future and working to make life multiplanetary," the company said in a statement. "We believe ownership of the company creating these systems should extend to the next generation of Americans for their long-term benefit." SpaceX Chief Operating Officer Gwynne Shotwell also agreed to make a personal gift of over 2 million SpaceX shares to Trump Accounts. Since the July 4 launch, families and friends have collectively contributed more than $1 billion to Trump Accounts . Total deposits now sit at more than $9 billion, CNBC first reported. Trump Accounts, also known as 530A accounts, are open to any U.S. child under 18 with a Social Security number. Parents, guardians, grandparents and others can collectively contribute up to $5,000 per child per year in after-tax dollars up until the year before the beneficiary turns 18. The annual contribution limit is indexed for inflation after 2027. Children born from 2025 through 2028 may receive a one-time $1,000 deposit from the Treasury. Other funds may also be available, depending on certain criteria. CNBC's Kevin Breuninger, Kate Dore and Jess Dickler contributed to this story This is a developing story.
